title: Peter Krause Enters the ‘Line of Fire’ and Opens Up About His Shocking ‘9-1-1’ Exit
summary: As he steps into his latest starring role in the new NBC action-thriller drama, the Emmy-nominated actor looks back on his storied TV career and opens up at length for the first time about leaving '9-1-1' last year: "It was a bigger deal, I think, than a lot of people thought it was going to be."
